title: Headache, visual disturbance or epigastric pain (pre-eclampsia screen)
summary: Headache, visual symptoms, epigastric/RUQ pain, or a raised blood pressure reading — screening for pre-eclampsia.

openingFields.label: Known risk factors (e.g. chronic hypertension, previous pre-eclampsia, multiple pregnancy)

pe-01.text: What is her most recent blood pressure reading?
pe-01.phoneText: Ask if she has a home BP monitor and what the last reading was, if any.

answers.label: Below 140/90 mmHg, or not yet known

citation.section: Hypertension in pregnancy — severe hypertension threshold (BP ≥160/110 mmHg = admit)

pe-02a.text: Does she have any of these symptoms right now: visual disturbance (flashing lights, blurring, or loss of vision), a severe headache not relieved by usual analgesia, epigastric or right-upper-quadrant pain, or persistent vomiting with headache?
pe-02a.phoneText: Ask specifically about each: flashing lights or blurred vision, a bad headache that won't go with paracetamol, pain under the ribs on the right, or being sick along with the headache.

pe-02b.phoneText: Ask specifically about each: flashing lights or blurred vision, a bad headache that won't go with paracetamol, pain under the ribs on the right, or being sick along with the headache.

pe-03.text: Are there any risk factors for pre-eclampsia — first pregnancy, previous pre-eclampsia, chronic hypertension, pre-existing diabetes, multiple pregnancy, BMI over 35, maternal age 40 or over, or family history?

answers.label: Yes — one or more risk factors

pe-outcome-red-severehtn.title: Severe hypertension (BP ≥160/110 mmHg)
actions: Arrange immediate transfer for admission — severe hypertension in pregnancy requires urgent assessment and treatment regardless of symptoms.
Repeat BP measurement to confirm; do not delay referral awaiting repeat if clearly severe.
Full pre-eclampsia bloods (FBC, U&E, LFTs), urine protein:creatinine ratio, and fetal assessment (CTG, growth/Doppler as indicated) to be arranged on arrival.
pe-outcome-red-severehtn.phoneScript: Tell her this blood pressure reading needs checking in hospital today, right away — please come in now, or call 999 if she also feels unwell, has severe headache, visual changes, or pain under the ribs.
safetyNetting: Call 999 immediately if a seizure occurs, or if she develops severe headache, visual loss, confusion, or feels very unwell before arrival.
documentationPrompts: Time of referral/admission and by whom.

citations.section: Hypertension in pregnancy — severe hypertension (BP ≥160/110 mmHg): admit

pe-outcome-red-severefeatures.title: Suspected severe pre-eclampsia (raised BP with severe symptoms)
actions: Full pre-eclampsia bloods (FBC, U&E, LFTs), urine protein:creatinine ratio, and fetal assessment (CTG, growth/Doppler as indicated) on arrival.
Escalate to obstetric team immediately — anticipate need for antihypertensive treatment and magnesium sulfate per local protocol if severe features confirmed.
See Eclampsia emergency drill if any seizure activity develops.
pe-outcome-red-severefeatures.phoneScript: Tell her these symptoms together with her blood pressure need checking in hospital right away — please come in now, or call 999 if symptoms are worsening quickly or she feels very unwell.
safetyNetting: Call 999 immediately if a seizure occurs, or if symptoms worsen rapidly on the way in.

pe-outcome-orange-raisedbp.title: Raised blood pressure (140/90–159/109 mmHg), no severe symptoms
pe-outcome-orange-raisedbp.target: Seen within 15 minutes (face-to-face) / attend within the hour (phone)
actions: Arrange same-day assessment — repeat BP, urine protein:creatinine ratio, pre-eclampsia bloods (FBC, U&E, LFTs).
Fetal assessment — CTG and consider growth/Doppler review if not recently done.
Discuss with obstetric team; consider need for antihypertensive treatment per local protocol.
pe-outcome-orange-raisedbp.phoneScript: Tell her this blood pressure needs checking today — please come in so we can repeat it, check her urine, and take some bloods.
safetyNetting: Come in immediately, any time, if she develops headache, visual disturbance, pain under the ribs, sudden swelling, or feels unwell before her appointment.

citations.section: Hypertension in pregnancy — management of non-severe hypertension

pe-outcome-orange-symptomsnormalbp.title: Possible pre-eclampsia symptoms with normal or unknown blood pressure
pe-outcome-orange-symptomsnormalbp.target: Seen within 15 minutes (face-to-face) / attend within the hour (phone)
actions: Arrange same-day assessment — pre-eclampsia symptoms warrant BP and urine protein checked even if a previous reading was normal, since pre-eclampsia can progress quickly.
Full pre-eclampsia bloods (FBC, U&E, LFTs) and fetal assessment (CTG).
pe-outcome-orange-symptomsnormalbp.phoneScript: Even though her blood pressure was normal before, these symptoms need checking today — please come in so we can reassess.
safetyNetting: Come in immediately, any time, if symptoms worsen, vision changes further, or she feels unwell before her appointment.
documentationPrompts: Most recent BP reading and when taken.

pe-outcome-yellow-riskfactors.title: Headache with pre-eclampsia risk factors, no red-flag symptoms
actions: Arrange same-day BP and urinalysis given risk factor(s) present, even without severe symptoms.
Simple analgesia advice per local formulary — the app does not give medication doses; signpost to local guidance/BNF.
pe-outcome-yellow-riskfactors.phoneScript: Given her history, tell her this still needs a blood pressure and urine check today, even though it sounds like a simple headache.
safetyNetting: Come in immediately, any time, if visual disturbance, pain under the ribs, sudden swelling, or feeling generally unwell develop.

citations.section: Hypertension in pregnancy — risk factors for pre-eclampsia

pe-outcome-green.title: Simple headache, no red-flag features or risk factors
actions: Reassure and advise simple measures (rest, hydration); signpost to local/BNF guidance for analgesia in pregnancy rather than giving medication advice directly.
Advise BP check at next routine contact if not done recently.
pe-outcome-green.phoneScript: Explain this sounds like a simple headache, but she should contact us again straight away — any time — if she notices visual changes, pain under the ribs, swelling, or if the headache becomes severe or doesn't settle.
safetyNetting: Contact the unit again immediately if visual disturbance, epigastric pain, sudden swelling, or severe/persistent headache develop.
documentationPrompts: Symptoms and risk factors screened — all negative.
